summary: Successfully implemented base branch compilation fixes per ADR-001. Key changes: (1) Added typealias AppSettings = SettingsStore to unify settings types, (2) Added convenience init() to SettingsStore for view compatibility, (3) Removed duplicate type definitions (AppSecretStore, CalendarEvent, SidecastPersona) that were shadowing canonical implementations, (4) Fixed MLX-specific issues: updated ParakeetBackend to use new transcribe() API with decoderState parameter, added missing .tdtJa case to all switch statements in OpenOatsLocalModelStore, fixed Repo.parakeet -> Repo.parakeetV3 reference. Build completes successfully with zero errors.

decisions.title: Consolidate AppSettings and SettingsStore via Typealias
decisions.rationale: SettingsStore has comprehensive @Observable implementation with 80+ properties including all mlx-audio and meeting detection features. Views use AppSettings. Typealias unifies types while preserving all functionality.

decisions.title: Remove Duplicate Types Instead of Restore
decisions.rationale: AppSecretStore, CalendarEvent, and SidecastPersona already existed in SettingsStorage.swift, MeetingTypes.swift, and SidecastModels.swift respectively. The 'restore' task was based on incorrect assumption that these types were missing. Removed duplicate files from Settings/ folder.

decisions.title: Fix MLX-Audio API Compatibility
decisions.rationale: FluidAudio library updated transcribe() API to require decoderState parameter. Added TdtDecoderState property to ParakeetBackend, initialized in prepare() with await asr.decoderLayerCount. Added missing .tdtJa case to exhaustive switch statements.
changes: ParakeetBackend: Added decoderState property, updated transcribe() to use new API
OpenOatsLocalModelStore: Added .tdtJa case to parakeetCurrentRelativePath(), parakeetLegacyRelativePath(), stableName()

decisions.title: Add Convenience Initializer for View Compatibility
decisions.rationale: SettingsStore requires init(storage:) but Views expect init(). Added convenience init() that calls self.init(storage: .live()).

mlx_verification: ParakeetBackend compiles with new decoderState API, all AsrModelVersion cases handled including .tdtJa
